title: UI Color System Compiler
description: Verifies color system spec: WCAG contrast ratios, semantic role completeness, interactive state deltas, no raw hex in semantic entries, focus indicator contrast

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract brand palette, semantic intent map, WCAG target, surface/foreground pairing rules

pipeline.title: Verify Color System
pipeline.description: Run all gates: contrast, semantic completeness, raw hex detection, focus contrast, mode coverage

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed attestation artifact for downstream theme and component compilers

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: color-system-spec.json exists with required fields: semanticRoles, pairings, modes

gates.title: Semantic Roles Complete
gates.description: All 7 required semantic roles declared: primary, secondary, destructive, success, warning, info, neutral

gates.title: WCAG Contrast Ratios
gates.description: Every foreground/background pairing meets the declared WCAG threshold (AA: 4.5:1, AAA: 7:1)

gates.title: Focus Indicator Contrast
gates.description: Focus indicator color has contrast ≥ 3:1 against the adjacent surface background

gates.title: No Raw Hex in Semantic Entries
gates.description: Semantic color entries must reference design tokens, not raw hex/rgb values

gates.title: Interactive State Deltas
gates.description: Every semantic role defines hover, focus, and active color deltas

gates.title: Mode Coverage
gates.description: Every semantic role has a color assignment for every declared mode (light, dark, high-contrast)

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK in color spec files

contracts.description: Structural requirements for a valid UI color system

error_codes.UCS003: Foreground/background pairing fails WCAG contrast threshold
error_codes.UCS004: Focus indicator fails 3:1 contrast against adjacent surface
error_codes.UCS005: Semantic entry uses raw hex value instead of token reference
error_codes.UCS006: Semantic role missing interactive state delta (hover/focus/active)
error_codes.UCS007: Semantic role not defined for a declared theme mode
error_codes.UCS008: TODO/FIXME/HACK found in color spec files
